title: Level 3 (Advanced) - D-23
notes:
West leads the ♥K against 4♠. The defense plays 3 rounds of hearts, South ruffing the third round. South has lost 2 tricks and has a possible club loser if East has the ♣Q. A trump loser is also possible if spades are 3-0 and South cashes the wrong top honor on the first round.

South can guarantee the contract without guessing spades as long as he cashes the ♠A on the first round of the suit. If South makes the mistake of winning the first spade trick with the ♠K, the contract will be safe unless East discards. West now has a certain trump trick and South will need the club finesse for his contract.

If South plays correctly and cashes the ♠A on the first round of trump, the contract is assured even if West discards. South should win a second round of trump with dummy's ♠K and eliminate diamonds by cashing the ♦K, the ♦A, and ruffing a diamond in the closed hand.

South exits in spades to East's ♠Q. East is endplayed. He must either lead a club into dummy's ♣AKJ or surrender a ruff and discard. In either case South makes his contract without resorting to the club finesse.
